# Text

Header: `winui/ui/text/Text.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/text/Text.hpp`.

A non-interactive run of text, the label of every form.

A plain string draws in the style the theme's type ramp gives its [role()](#role) (Body by default), in the theme's window text color. [set_text_style()](#set_text_style), [set_color()](#set_color) and [set_foreground()](#set_foreground) override them. The text can wrap ([set_wrapping()](#set_wrapping)), trim with an ellipsis ([set_trimming()](#set_trimming)), align and justify ([set_text_alignment()](#set_text_alignment)), and carry formatted runs and links ([set_inlines()](#set_inlines)). With [set_selection_enabled()](#set_selection_enabled), the user can select and copy it. Otherwise it takes no input or focus. In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::Text`](#uitext).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{.text = "Settings", .role = ui::TextRole::Title},
        ui::Text{.text     = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); }),
                 .wrapping = ui::TextWrapping::WrapWholeWords},
        ui::Button{.text = "Click me", .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; }},
    },
});

// Or imperatively, with formatted runs and a link:
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto block = std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>();
block->set_inlines({
    {.text = "Read the "},
    {.text = "release notes", .on_click = [] { /* open them */ }},
    ui::line_break(),
    {.text = "before updating.", .weight = ui::FontWeight::Bold},
});
block->set_wrapping(ui::TextWrapping::WrapWholeWords);
block->set_selection_enabled(true);
ui::TextControl* observer = stack->add(std::move(block)); // the stack owns it now
```

## `ui::Text`

A run of non-interactive text. Builds a [ui::TextControl](#uitextcontrol).

The text is a constant string, or a [`bind()`](../core/namespace-ui.md#bind) so the label follows a [Property](../core/property.md). The font comes from the theme's type ramp through [`.role`](#uitext-role), such as `TextRole::Caption` or `TextRole::Subtitle`. [`.text_style`](#uitext-text_style) sets a style for this label alone.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int>    clicks{0};
ui::Control<ui::Text> status;

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{ .text = "Appearance", .role = ui::TextRole::Subtitle },
        ui::Text{ .text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); }) },
        ui::Text{ .text     = "A longer paragraph that wraps at the width the parent offers.",
                  .wrapping = ui::TextWrapping::Wrap,
                  .control  = status },
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Text{
    .text, .inlines, .selection_enabled, .role, .text_style, .wrapping, .text_alignment,
    .character_spacing, .selection_highlight_color, .foreground, .trimming, .style, .margin,
    .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility,
    .on_text_trimmed_changed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus,
    .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uitext-text"></span>`text` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The displayed string (UTF-8). Ignored when [`.inlines`](#uitext-inlines) is set. |
| <span id="uitext-inlines"></span>`inlines` | `ui::Binding<std::vector<ui::Inline>>` |  | Runs with their own formatting, line breaks and links (ui/text/Inlines.hpp). When set, they are the content and [`.text`](#uitext-text) is ignored. |
| <span id="uitext-selection_enabled"></span>`selection_enabled` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{false}` | The user can select the text with the pointer or keyboard and copy it. |
| <span id="uitext-role"></span>`role` | `ui::Binding<ui::TextRole>` | `{ui::TextRole::Body}` | The step of the theme's type ramp the text uses, such as Caption or Subtitle. It follows a theme change. |
| <span id="uitext-text_style"></span>`text_style` | `ui::Binding<std::optional<ui::TextStyle>>` |  | A style for this label alone. When set, the theme's type ramp no longer applies to this label. |
| <span id="uitext-wrapping"></span>`wrapping` | `ui::Binding<ui::TextWrapping>` | `{ui::TextWrapping::NoWrap}` | Whether the text breaks into lines at the width the parent offers. |
| <span id="uitext-text_alignment"></span>`text_alignment` | `ui::Binding<ui::TextAlignment>` | `{ui::TextAlignment::Left}` | How each line sits between the left and right edges. |
| <span id="uitext-character_spacing"></span>`character_spacing` | `ui::Binding<int>` | `{0}` | Extra space between characters, in thousandths of an em. |
| <span id="uitext-selection_highlight_color"></span>`selection_highlight_color` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | The color behind selected text: a fixed color or a theme resource, which follows theme switches. Unset is the accent. |
| <span id="uitext-foreground"></span>`foreground` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | The text color: a fixed color, or a theme resource re-read on a theme change. Unset uses the theme's text color. |
| <span id="uitext-trimming"></span>`trimming` | `ui::Binding<ui::TextTrimming>` | `{ui::TextTrimming::None}` | What shows when the text does not fit: all of it clipped, or an ellipsis (plain text only). |
| <span id="uitext-on_text_trimmed_changed"></span>`on_text_trimmed_changed` | `ui::Callback<void(bool)>` |  | Fires with the new state whenever layout starts or stops cutting the text off. Only with [`.trimming`](#uitext-trimming) set. |
| <span id="uitext-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uitext-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uitext-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uitext-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uitext-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uitext-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uitext-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Text>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### TextControl

```cpp
TextControl() = default
```

An empty label.

### TextControl

```cpp
TextControl(std::string text)
```

A label showing [`text`](#text) (UTF-8) as one plain run.

### text

```cpp
const std::string& text() const
```

The content as UTF-8; with inlines, their texts joined (line breaks as `\n`).

### set_text

```cpp
void set_text(std::string text)
```

Replaces the content with one plain run, and drops any inlines and the selection.

### inlines

```cpp
const std::vector<Inline>& inlines() const
```

The formatted runs; empty for plain text (the default, and after [set_text()](#set_text)).

### set_inlines

```cpp
void set_inlines(std::vector<Inline> inlines)
```

Replaces the content with formatted runs. [text()](#text) becomes the runs' text joined. Clears the selection. An inline with `on_click` or `navigate_uri` is a link.

### text_alignment

```cpp
TextAlignment text_alignment() const
```

How each line sits between the left and right edges; Left by default.

### set_text_alignment

```cpp
void set_text_alignment(TextAlignment alignment)
```

Sets the line alignment.

### character_spacing

```cpp
int character_spacing() const
```

Extra space between characters, in thousandths of an em; 0 by default.

### set_character_spacing

```cpp
void set_character_spacing(int spacing)
```

Sets the extra space between characters, in thousandths of an em ([TextStyle::character_spacing](../rendering/text-style.md#character_spacing)).

### selection_enabled

```cpp
bool selection_enabled() const
```

Whether the user can select and copy the text; false by default. While true the block is focusable.

### set_selection_enabled

```cpp
void set_selection_enabled(bool enabled)
```

Turns text selection on or off. While on, the user selects by dragging, double-clicking a word or triple-clicking a paragraph. Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C and a context menu with Copy and Select All act on the selection, and a click focuses the block. Turning it off clears the selection.

### selection_highlight_color

```cpp
std::optional<Color> selection_highlight_color() const
```

The fixed color behind selected text; nullopt (the default) when unset or a theme resource is set. Unset is the accent.

### selection_highlight_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor selection_highlight_resource() const
```

The color behind selected text as a theme resource, or nullptr.

### set_selection_highlight_color

```cpp
void set_selection_highlight_color(std::optional<Color> color)
```

Sets the fixed color behind selected text and clears a theme resource; nullopt goes back to the accent.

### set_selection_highlight_color

```cpp
void set_selection_highlight_color(ThemeColor resource)
```

Sets the color behind selected text to a theme resource, re-read under every theme, and clears a fixed one.

### selection

```cpp
std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t> selection() const
```

The selection as [start, end) byte offsets into [text()](#text) (inlines joined); {0, 0} when none.

### select

```cpp
void select(std::size_t start, std::size_t end)
```

Selects the byte range [start, end) of [text()](#text). The selection shows only while the block has focus and selection is enabled.

### select_all

```cpp
void select_all()
```

Selects the whole text, as Ctrl+A does.

### selected_text

```cpp
std::string selected_text() const
```

The selected part of the laid-out text; empty when nothing is selected or before the first measure.

### text_style

```cpp
const TextStyle& text_style() const
```

The explicit style set by [set_text_style()](#set_text_style). Meaningful only once [set_text_style()](#set_text_style) was called. Until then the theme's type ramp entry for [role()](#role) is used.

### set_text_style

```cpp
void set_text_style(TextStyle style)
```

Fixes the font, size, weight and alignment. From then on it takes precedence over [role()](#role) and the theme's type ramp.

### role

```cpp
TextRole role() const
```

The role this label plays in the theme's `type` ramp; Body by default. The style is looked up in the current theme, so a plain [TextControl](#uitextcontrol) follows the theme's own fonts. [set_text_style()](#set_text_style) always takes precedence.

### set_role

```cpp
void set_role(TextRole role)
```

Sets the type ramp role.

### wrapping

```cpp
TextWrapping wrapping() const
```

Whether the text breaks into lines; NoWrap by default.

### set_wrapping

```cpp
void set_wrapping(TextWrapping wrapping)
```

Sets the wrapping mode. Anything but NoWrap wins over the wrapping of a style from [set_text_style()](#set_text_style). NoWrap, the default, leaves that style's own [`wrapping`](#wrapping) in charge. [Text](#uitext) wraps only at a bounded width, and a horizontal [StackControl](../layout/stack.md#uistackcontrol) offers an unbounded one.

### color

```cpp
std::optional<Color> color() const
```

The fixed text color, if any. Unset (the default) uses the theme's window text color, so a label without [set_color()](#set_color) stays readable under a dark theme.

### set_color

```cpp
void set_color(Color color)
```

Fixes the text color and clears any [set_foreground()](#set_foreground) resource. A fixed color does not follow a theme change.

### set_foreground

```cpp
void set_foreground(ThemeColor resource)
```

Sets the text color to a theme resource, re-read whenever the text is drawn so it follows a theme change. Wins over [set_color()](#set_color); nullptr clears it.

### trimming

```cpp
TextTrimming trimming() const
```

What shows when the text does not fit the arranged box: all of it clipped (None, Clip), or as much as fits followed by an ellipsis, cut between characters or between words. Only the plain-text form trims (not inlines, selectable or justified text).

### set_trimming

```cpp
void set_trimming(TextTrimming trimming)
```

Sets the trimming mode.

### is_text_trimmed

```cpp
bool is_text_trimmed() const
```

Whether the last arrange cut the text short.

### on_text_trimmed_changed

```cpp
void on_text_trimmed_changed(Callback<void(bool)> handler)
```

Fires during arrange with the new [is_text_trimmed()](#is_text_trimmed) value whenever it changes. A typical use is a tooltip that shows the full text.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring reads only the text's own state, the measurer and the theme.

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

Focusable only while enabled with text selection on.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the block has keyboard focus (only ever true while [focusable()](#focusable)).

### handle_context_menu

```cpp
bool handle_context_menu(std::optional<Point> position, ContextMenuHost& host) override
```

Offers Copy / Select All while selection is enabled; returns false (no menu) otherwise.

### cursor_at

```cpp
std::optional<CursorShape> cursor_at(Point p) const override
```

A hand over a link, an I-beam over selectable text.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Always AutomationRole::Text.

### automation_name_fallback

```cpp
std::string automation_name_fallback() const override
```

The text, when no accessibility name is set.

### automation_children

```cpp
void automation_children(std::vector<Element*>& out) const override
```

One node per link inline. Invoking a node follows its link.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The text's size in DIPs in the resolved style, wrapped to `available.width` when wrapping.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Re-flows laid-out content to the arranged width and applies trimming (which may fire [on_text_trimmed_changed()](#on_text_trimmed_changed)).

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

The text, or the laid-out runs with the selection highlight (while focused) and link underlines.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

Selection drags and multi-clicks, and link clicks; ignored while disabled.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool) override
```

Tracks focus. The selection shows only while the block has focus.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Ctrl+A (select all) and Ctrl+C (copy), only while enabled with selection on.

### draws_focus_ring

```cpp
bool draws_focus_ring() const override
```

None: selectable text shows focus through its selection.

## Enumerations

### TextTrimming

```cpp
enum class TextTrimming
```

What a [TextControl](#uitextcontrol) shows when its text does not fit the arranged box.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `None` | All of the text, clipped at the box (the default). |
| `CharacterEllipsis` | As much as fits, cut between characters, then an ellipsis. |
| `WordEllipsis` | As much as fits, cut between words, then an ellipsis. |
| `Clip` | All of the text, clipped at the box. |
